svg.aria-label: Figure 1. Three panels. A: an image of 576 visual tokens pruned to 192, 128 and 64. B: a signal rounded to 4, 3, 2 and 1 bits. C: a model card — Suzukitakeko, Shanghai; research: Efficient AI, the training and inference of foundation models; attends to token pruning, KV cache, quantization and fast inference.
